title: Unified CT and MRI Pancreas Segmentation for Label-Efficient Cross-Modality Subregion Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2609.13043v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robust medical image segmentation across imaging modalities is challenging because of large differences in appearance and intensity distributions. Models trained on a single modality often show substantial performance drops when applied to unseen domains. In this work, we develop a unified 3D pancreas segmentation framework that applies domain-adversarial learning to 4,604 heterogeneous CT and MRI scans to learn anatomical representations. A shared nnU-Net encoder-decoder is trained for whole-pancreas segmentation, with a latent domain discriminator encouraging CT-MRI feature alignment. The learned encoder is subsequently transferred to pancreatic head-body-tail segmentation using limited MRI-only subregion annotations. An average Dice score of 87.31% on the in-distribution test set and Dice scores ranging from 84.20% to 88.09% across external OOD datasets were achieved in whole pancreas segmentation. translated_title: 统一的CT和MRI胰腺分割：面向标签高效的跨模态亚区域迁移
translated_abstract: 由于外观和强度分布的巨大差异，跨成像模态的鲁棒医学图像分割极具挑战性。在单一模态上训练的模型应用于未见过的域时往往会出现显著的性能下降。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个统一的3D胰腺分割框架，将域对抗学习应用于4,604例异构的CT和MRI扫描以学习解剖学表征。一个共享的nnU-Net编码器-解码器被训练用于全胰腺分割，同时利用一个潜在域判别器促使CT与MRI的特征对齐。随后，学到的编码器被迁移至胰头-体-尾分割任务中，仅使用有限数量的MRI亚区域标注。在全胰腺分割任务中，模型在分布内测试集上取得了87.31%的平均Dice分数，在多个外部OOD数据集上取得了84.20%至88.09%的Dice分数。在M（原文摘要于此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个统一的3D胰腺分割框架，通过对4,604例异构CT与MRI扫描进行域对抗学习实现跨模态特征对齐，并将学到的编码器以极少的MRI标注高效迁移至胰头-体-尾亚区域分割，在全胰腺及外部OOD数据集上均取得优异表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified 3D pancreas segmentation framework that applies domain-adversarial learning to 4,604 heterogeneous CT and MRI scans for cross-modality feature alignment, enabling label-efficient transfer of the learned encoder to pancreatic head-body-tail subregion segmentation with only limited MRI annotations.
